candidateStrategy: representative failure-mode coverage; remaining candidates stay gated
derivationRules: Micro is derived from the canonical 24px Line master.
Semantic identity and canonical naming never change.
Remove secondary detail before altering the primary contour.
Merge or omit geometry only when recognition improves at 12px or 16px.
Preserve directional terminals and interaction cues.
Protect critical counters, nodes, modifiers and negative-space gaps.
Optical rebalancing may keep complexity flat when it improves recognition.
Brand marks remain separately gated and are not included in Micro 0.2.

icons.name: archive
changes: converted internal plus into a short archive slot
icons.review: The archive box remains the dominant cue while the small plus is prevented from competing with the object metaphor.

icons.name: cart
icons.review: The cart remains unchanged semantically; the wheels receive optical emphasis because they are the only small detached components.

icons.name: copy
changes: preserved two-sheet overlap with simplified rear-sheet termination
icons.review: Two offset sheets remain the semantic cue; the rear sheet terminates cleanly before the overlap becomes a dark corner.

icons.name: database
changes: reduced three repeated body rows to one continuous cylinder body
icons.review: The top ellipse and continuous cylindrical body retain the database metaphor while removing a stacked line that collapses at 12px.

icons.name: edit
icons.review: The diagonal pencil silhouette remains dominant; the internal seam was secondary and visually merges at Micro sizes.

icons.name: git-branch
icons.review: All three branch nodes remain because topology is the semantic cue; only node scale is optically rebalanced.

icons.name: loading
changes: replaced eight radial spokes with one open activity arc
icons.review: The open arc keeps the activity/loading cue while removing the sun-like radial reading risk from the canonical spoke wheel.

icons.name: map
changes: preserved both fold divisions and outer silhouette
icons.review: The map's three-panel topology is already the minimum semantic structure; no detail was removed because doing so would collapse the map metaphor.

icons.name: volume-off
changes: shortened speaker stem while preserving mute cross
icons.review: The speaker body and crossing mute mark are both semantic; the speaker stem is shortened to keep the cross visually separate.

icons.name: warning
changes: preserved triangle and enlarged exclamation terminal spacing
icons.review: The warning triangle and exclamation are both essential; the Micro treatment keeps both cues intact rather than simplifying the status symbol into a generic triangle.
